change: The frozen primary test enumerates all 2**n sign assignments. That is tractable for the 16-episode design (65,536 means) but not for the 88-episode sealed test (2**88 is about 3e26). Enumeration is retained for n <= 20; above it the identical null is sampled with 200,000 draws under seed 20260825. The estimand, the endpoint and the one-sided direction are unchanged; only how the null distribution is obtained differs.
evidence: analyze_symbol_relational_probe.py raised ValueError('Maximum allowed dimension exceeded') while building the null, so relational_probe_results.json had not been written when the amendment was made.
v1_verification: Re-running the 16-episode run under the amended code reproduces every patching value exactly (maximum absolute difference 0.0 across 53 numeric leaves), keeps the scheme string 'exact episode-level sign flip', and leaves the stability gate unchanged. Only a descriptive null_draws field is added.
